snippet.title: Beautiful Life
snippet.description:
Hello
I am one of the huge fans of pianist Seong-Jin Cho.
I opened a channel to share his music, which was broadcast around the world, in the hope that we could share joy and great consolation from his music. Even if there are some shortcomings, please be generous.

And, 
there seems to be a misunderstanding about the advertisement for SJ Cho's music that I upload.
I don't take any profit from SJ Cho's music. In YouTube terms, I am not affiliated with the YouTube Partner Program.

It is the policy of Google, the YouTube platform provider, to insert advertisements into the music I upload, and I do not know who gets the revenue from that ad. There will be people who claim to be the owners of the soundtrack. 

So, Google is probably selling YouTube PREMIUM to people who want to play music seamlessly.

Please understand that I have no control over the ads for the music I upload, and I am not a monetizer through this channel.
I hope you all be happy with SJ CHO's music. Thank you.

snippet.title: /부후우BOOWHOWOO
snippet.description:
여러분 안녕하세요. 부후우입니다.  액체괴물  만들기, 신기한 실험,가루쿡,장난감소개,레고만들기,요리...
10살 부후우가 일본어와 한국어로 다양한 것에 도전중입니다.
유치원 때부터 하고 싶었던 유튜브 채널을 초등학교 입학을 기회로 2015년 3월, 8살 때 시작했습니다.
많은 시청이 힘이 되고요, 많이 사랑해 주시고 구독해 주시면 감사합니다 ^▽^
*************************
みなさんこんにちは、ブーフーウーです。
幼稚園時代から憧れていたかんなとあきらちゃんのチャンネルのように自分もいろんなものを紹介したいと2015年３月、7歳のBOOWHOWOOが小学校入学記念に始めました(現在10歳）
日本語と韓国語でおもちゃレビューや実験などの紹介動画をアップしています。
登録してくれたらうれしいです❤
*********************************************
Hi, I'm BOOWHOWOO, 10 years old girl, introducing you easy Cooking, 
funny Experiments, weird Japanese sweets and Lego, etc in Japanese and Korean with English subtitles.
Do you like them?!  Yes, I know you do. 
So visit and subscribe me now.  
Don't miss it! 
*********************************************
Retrouvez les trucs et astuces de la vie 
quotidienne de BOOWHOWOO sur notre Chaine Youtube!

*********************************************
大家好！歡迎收看BOOWHOWOO，
8歲妹妹BOOWHOWOO挑戰烹飪、實驗、玩具和零食之評論，及以日語和韓文介紹給大家，
歡迎訂閱和分享! 謝謝!
